audio.text: Do you want to study together tonight?

options: Yes, the study is on the left.

why.en: Offer → suggesting a time. B uses "study" to mean a room.
why.tr: Teklif → saat önerisi. B "study" kelimesini oda anlamında kullanıyor.
why.es: Oferta → proponer una hora. B usa "study" con el sentido de una habitación.
